summary: Test a DNS credential with a read

parameters.name: credentialID
parameters.description: ID of the DNS credential, as the list shows it

200.description: The result of the test; a refused or failed provider call is a state of a 200 answer, not an error

404.description: The credential does not exist or belongs to another user

description:
Reads through the saved credential once: the first page of the provider's zone list and, when the credential has a domain and the provider can read records, one A record read at the first domain's apex (a missing record is fine). The write right cannot be tested without a change. Nothing is stored and no audit entry is written. For a provider without a read call (`supported` false) no outside request is made.

Needs: Certificates manage
